    Our Story

    One printer.
    One town.
    Zero chill.

    House of Madese started in Ichalkaranji — a textile town that's been making things for a century — with one 3D printer and the idea that Indian homes deserve objects with actual personality. We design everything ourselves, print in tough PETG, and hand-finish every single piece. GST-registered, Udyam-registered, and unreasonably obsessed with layer quality.

    How A Madese Piece Is Born

    Not a factory line. A pipeline we built ourselves — and we'll happily show you the messy middle on Instagram.

    Step 01 / Design

    Sketched in CAD

    Every piece starts as parametric geometry we model in-house. If it looks like everything else on Amazon, it gets deleted.

    Step 02 / Slice

    Sliced & tuned

    Wall counts, infill, supports — tuned per product so it's strong where it matters and light where it doesn't.

    Step 03 / Print

    Grown layer by layer

    Printed in PETG on our farm. Hours per piece. The layer lines aren't a flaw — they're the signature.

    Step 04 / Finish

    Hand-finished

    Deburred, checked, and packed by an actual human in Ichalkaranji who will take it personally if it arrives ugly.

    Before you order

    The quick answers. Anything else, we're one WhatsApp message away.

    How long until it reaches me?

    In-stock pieces dispatch within 48 hours. Made-to-order pieces are printed after you order and dispatch in 3–6 working days. Delivery then takes 3–7 working days depending on your PIN code, and we send tracking on WhatsApp.

    Can I pay cash on delivery?

    Yes. Pick Cash on Delivery at checkout and we confirm your order on WhatsApp before it goes to print. You can also pay online with UPI, cards or netbanking through Razorpay.

    What if it arrives damaged?

    Send a photo or video and your order ID on WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery. We reprint and reship for free, or refund you, your choice.

    Can I get something personalised?

    Yes. On the photo lamps and other custom pieces you can upload a reference photo and tell us the names, colours, style or size you want, right on the product page.

    How do I get the launch discount?

    Add anything to your cart and the 20% launch offer (code FIRSTLAYER) is applied for you automatically.

    Promo Code

    ⚠️ After changing this, also update coupons.json the same way you sync prices — the server won't apply a discount it doesn't know about.

    Payments (Razorpay)

    Your Razorpay keys live safely in Vercel, not in this file. In Vercel → Project → Settings → Environment Variables, add:
    • RAZORPAY_KEY_ID = your rzp_test_… (later rzp_live_…) key
    • RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET = the secret shown next to it
    The full checklist file walks you through it. Nothing to enter here.

    ⚠️ After changing any PRICE

    Prices are verified on the server from a file called products.json. When you change a price here, you must also update that one number in products.json and re-upload it, or checkout will charge the old price. The checklist explains this — it's one line per product.
